rules.place: a point is in the member state whose Natural Earth 1:50m polygon holds it, and in none when another state's polygon holds it; at sea, in the member state whose waters hold it (an exclusive economic zone with one sovereign, Marine Regions' World EEZ v12), and in none where two or more states claim or share the waters; otherwise in the state whose land is nearest within 10 km, when it is a member. Where a publisher names each point's state (PortWatch), a point counts for a member state only where the publisher names it too. A line's length counts toward each state by the part inside its polygon, on the WGS84 ellipsoid (derived). This says whose waters a point is in, not where a boundary lies in law
rules.activity: derived: the sum of the publisher's daily figures over each complete calendar year (UTC), counted only where every day of the year is in the file
rules.join: a USGS port is a PortWatch port only by published keys: USGS's World Port Index ID, NGA's World Port Index (the index number's UN/LOCODE, the same code with or without its space) and PortWatch's LOCODE, where each step gives exactly one port; never by name or distance
